fieldValues.title: How does a received report become a record that changes the practice?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Receipt is a throttle and only that: it lifts the pause and reads nothing. 36 of 37 reports received; 0 records derived from any; the same lessons recur in section 7 for days; 8 measurement results wait on an evaluator the owner has never given; no retrospective held. The handbook specifies the loop (rate indicators, retrospective per period, propose a decision when a lesson recurs) and nothing runs it.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Status quo: a +1 and a receives relation. Leads to: the group runs on; lessons stay in prose.
- The steward records recurrence: when a section-7 lesson repeats a previous report, the steward writes a finding derived-from both reports that evidences the stage and the problem; the finding enters the existing flow-stop machinery. Leads to: learning without the owner; depends on the steward reading its own reports (it already does) and on findings being read (0 of 64 affirmed).
- Receipt asks one question: the session shows section 7 before the receive key and offers noted / make a finding / rate the indicator. Leads to: the 5-second act becomes a 10-second judgement; fills the empty evaluators as a side effect; keeps the owner in the loop at the cheapest point.
- A retrospective per period: one session kind (clerk#59) over every report's section 7 since the last, the pending evaluators and escalations older than three days, producing one keep/change/drop decision derived-from the reports. Leads to: the loop the handbook specifies; one more session kind for the owner, but batched.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which lessons in the 37 reports' section 7 would have produced a change if recorded, and which were noise? (A hand pass over them is the cheapest test, and this review did part of it: builder not triggered, draft proposal invisible, ruling has no route, budget 0 of 10, rejected PRs need a builder, I1 window empty.) Is a finding nobody affirms better than a report nobody reads?
fieldValues.next_action: Pass over the 37 reports' section 7 once, file the recurring lessons as findings derived-from the reports, and count how many turn into an issue within a week. That number decides between the steward option and the retrospective option.
